limitations: Only Infinite Impermanence has the registered Normal Trap root packet.
The catalogue and fixture fields are technical data, not full TCG ruling or prior-history certification.

Target-immunity, malformed-source, phase and pending-chain gate probes are explicitly un-replayed state probes. The all-five blocked-column case uses an explicitly marked QA-only aggregate lock fixture, not a physically certified five-copy route; other positive scenarios use actual physical cards and registered transitions.
General priority, arbitrary chains and Damage Step remain outside scope.
